40018301.author: पदार्थः
40018301.content: दीनः piteous, परमदुःखितः very sad, सःराजा that king, सभाम् council, प्रविश्य entered, क्रुद्धः angry, सिंहःइव like lion, श्वसन् sighing, मुख्ये chief, आसने seat, निषसाद sat

40018301.author: Translation
40018301.content: Ravana, the king entered the council, angry like a lion, looking piteous, very sad and sat on the seat.

40018302.author: पदार्थः
40018302.content: महाबलः endowed with mighty prowess, पुत्रव्यसनकर्शितः shrunken on account of son, सःरावणः that Ravana, प्राञ्जलिः greeting with folded hands, तान् them, सर्वान् all, बलमुख्यान् army chiefs, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीच्छ spoke

40018302.author: Translation
40018302.content: Ravana, endowed with mighty prowess, shrunken on account of his son, greeting all the army chiefs with folded hands spoke as follows.

40018303.author: पदार्थः
40018303.content: सर्वे all, भवन्तः of you, सर्वेण all, हस्त्वश्वेन elephants horses, समावृताः collected, रथसङ्घैश्च also chariots, पादातैश्च foot soldiers too, उपशोभिताः shining, निर्यान्तु march

40018303.author: Translation
40018303.content: Let all of you, equipped with every elephant and horse, march forth resplendent with hosts of chariots and foot-soldiers.

40018304.author: पदार्थः
40018304.content: एकम् one, रामम् Rama, परिक्षिप्य encompassing, समरे in war, प्रावृटकाले monsoon, अम्बुदाःइव like the sky, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, वर्षन्तः raining, हन्तुम् kill, अर्हथ ought to do

40018304.author: Translation
40018304.content: Encircling the lone Rama in battle, you ought to slay him, raining showers of arrows like clouds at the time of the monsoon.

40018305.author: पदार्थः
40018305.content: अथवा or else, अहम् I, महाहवे huge, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, भवद्भि: भिन्नगात्रम् limbs are struck by you, रामम् Rama, लोकस्य world, पश्यतः looks at, श्वः I, निहन्तास्मि I shall kill

40018305.author: Translation
40018305.content: "I shall kill him with huge sharp arrows as the world looks at Rama, once his limbs are struck by you."

40018306.author: पदार्थः
40018306.content: ते they, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, इति thus, एतत् all that, वाक्यम् words, आदाय hearing, शीघ्रैः swiftly, रथैः on chariots, नानानीकैश्च diverse battalions, संयुताः together, निर्ययुः departed

40018306.author: Translation
40018306.content: On Rakshasa king speaking like that, all the diverse battalions together departed swiftly on chariots.

40018307.author: पदार्थः
40018307.content: सर्वे all, शरीरान्तकरान् capable of destroying the life of body, परिघान् iron bars, पट्टसांश्चव clubs, शरखङ्गपरश्वधान् arrows. swords and axes, वानरान् प्रति on Vanaras, चिक्षिपुः hurled, वानराश्च Vanaras, राक्षसान् प्रति over Rakshasas, द्रुमान् trees, शैलान् rocks, चिक्षिपुः attacked

40018307.author: Translation
40018307.content: All the Rakshasas threw at the Vanaras iron bars, clubs, axes, swords, and arrows, which were capable of destroying the life. Vanaras also attacked Rakshasas with trees and rocks.

40018308.author: पदार्थः
40018308.content: सूर्यस्य Sun, उदयनंप्रति started at rise, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणां च Vanaras, महाभीमः most terrific, सःसङ्ग्रामः war, तुमुलः tumultuous, समपद्यत became

40018308.author: Translation
40018308.content: By the time of sunrise, the most terrific war started between Vanaras and Rakshasas, which became tumultuous.

40018309.author: पदार्थः
40018309.content: ते they, वानरराक्षसाः Vanaras and Rakshasas, तदा then, चित्राभिः wonderful, गदाभिः maces, प्रासैः darts, खडगैः swords, परश्वधैः axes, समरे in war, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नुः attacked

40018309.author: Translation
40018309.content: The Vanaras and Rakshasas attacked one another with wonderful maces, darts, swords, and axes in war.

40018310.author: पदार्थः
40018310.content: एवम् in that manner, सङ्ग्रामे in war, प्रवृत्ते in progress, अद्भुतम् wonderful, सुमहत् huge, रजःdust, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणां च Vanaras also, शोणितविस्रवैः by the flow of blood, शान्तम् subsided

40018310.author: Translation
40018310.content: As the war was in progress, wonderful dust had risen which subsided by the flow of blood of Vanaras and Rakshasas.

40018311.author: पदार्थः
40018311.content: मातङ्गरथकूलाः elephants and chariots as banks, वाजिमत्स्याः horses like fish, ध्वजद्रुमाः staffs as trees, शरीरसङ्घाटवहाः dead bodies as logs of wood, शोणितापगाः rivers of blood, प्रसस्रुः flowed

40018311.author: Translation
40018311.content: There with rivers of blood flowing, elephants and chariots were like banks, horses were like fish, staff of chariots like trees and dead bodies as logs of wood seemed.

40018312.author: पदार्थः
40018312.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, ते of them, वानराः Vanaras, शोणितौघपरिप्लुताः bathed in blood, समरे in war, वानरेन्द्राः leaders of Vanaras, ध्वजवर्मरथान् staff of chariots, अश्वान् horses, नानाप्रहरणानि च all kinds of weapons, आप्लुत्य leaping, आप्लुत्य and jumping, बभञ्जिरे broke

40018312.author: Translation
40018312.content: Leaping and jumping the Vanaras and also the leaders of Vanaras bathed in blood broke all kinds of weapons, staff of chariots and the horses.

40018313.author: पदार्थः
40018313.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, ते of them, वानराः Vanaras, शोणितौघपरिप्लुताः bathed in blood, समरे in war, वानरेन्द्राः leaders of Vanaras, ध्वजवर्मरथान् staff of chariots, अश्वान् horses, नानाप्रहरणानि च all kinds of weapons, आप्लुत्य leaping, आप्लुत्य and jumping, बभञ्जिरे broke

40018313.author: Translation
40018313.content: Leaping and jumping the Vanaras and also the leaders of Vanaras bathed in blood broke all kinds of weapons, staff of chariots and the horses.

40018314.author: पदार्थः
40018314.content: प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, दशनैः teeth, नखैश्चापि nails, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, केशान् hair, कर्णललाटांश्च ears, forehead, नासिकाश्चापि noses, व्यकर्तयन् tore off

40018314.author: Translation
40018314.content: The monkeys with their sharp teeth and nails tore off the hair, ears, noses, and forehead of the Rakshasas,

40018315.author: पदार्थः
40018315.content: सङ्ख्ये number of, एकैकम् each one, राक्षसम् of the Rakshasas, शतम् hundred, वानरपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, फलिनम् laden with fruits, वृक्षम् trees, शकुनयोयथा like birds, अभ्यधावन्त attacked

40018315.author: Translation
40018315.content: Just as trees laden with fruits are attacked by birds, each one of the Rakshasas was attacked by hundreds of Vanaras.

40018316.author: पदार्थः
40018316.content: तदा then, पर्वतोपमाः mountain like forms, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, गुर्वीभिः heavy, गदाभिः maces, प्रासैःखडगैः darts, swords, परश्वधैः axes, घोरान्frightening, वानरान् Vanaras, निर्जघ्नुः struck

40018316.author: Translation
40018316.content: Then the mountainlike forms of Rakshasas attacked the Vanaras with heavy maces, darts, swords, and axes in frightening ways.

40018317.author: पदार्थः
40018317.content: राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वध्यमानानाम् being struck, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महाचमूः huge group, शरण्यम् refuge, दशरथात्मजम् Dasharatha's son, रामम् Rama, शरणम् protection, याता sought

40018317.author: Translation
40018317.content: The Vanaras being struck by Rakshasas sought the protection of Rama, the son of Dasharatha.

40018318.author: पदार्थः
40018318.content: ततः then, महातेजाः highly energetic, वीर्यवान् valiant one, रामः Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking up, राक्षसम् Rakshasas, सैन्यम् army, प्रविश्यentered, शरवर्षम् rain of arrows, ववर्ष ह showered

40018318.author: Translation
40018318.content: Then, the highly energetic and valiant Rama, taking up the bow showered rain of arrows on Rakshasa army.

40018319.author: पदार्थः
40018319.content: तदा then, प्रविष्टम् entered, शराग्निना like fire of arrows, निर्दहन्तम् consuming, रामम् Rama, महाघोराः most dreadful, अम्बरे sky, मेघाः clouds, सूर्यमिव like sun, नाधिजग्मुःnot approach

40018319.author: Translation
40018319.content: Then Rama entered the army with fire like arrows which were consuming the Rakshasas like the clouds in the sky which can't approach the scorching Sun.

40018320.author: पदार्थः
40018320.content: ते those, रजनीचराः night rangers, रणे in war, रामेण by Rama, कृतानि deeds, सुघोराणि terrible, असुकराणि difficult for others, रामस्य Rama's, कर्माण्येव his action, ददृशुः could not see

40018320.author: Translation
40018320.content: The night rangers were able to see Rama's terrible action which was difficult for others only after he had performed not otherwise (as they could not see his quick movement).

40018321.author: पदार्थः
40018321.content: ते those, महासैन्यम् great army, चालयन्तम् moving, महारथान् huge chariots, विधमन्तम् breaking, रामम् Rama, वनगतम् blowing in the forest, वातंयथा wind like, न ददृशुः not see

40018321.author: Translation
40018321.content: They could not see Rama while he was moving and breaking huge chariots as one would not be able to see the trees in the forest when the wind blew fast.

40018322.author: पदार्थः
40018322.content: रामेण by Rama, शरैः arrows, छिन्नम् shattered, भिन्नम्into pieces, शस्त्रपीडितम् tormented with darts, बलम् army, ददृशुःbeheld, शीघ्रकारिणम् one who is very fast in action, रामम् Rama, न not make out

40018322.author: Translation
40018322.content: They saw the army shattered, broken into pieces, tormented with darts by Rama but could not make out Rama who was very fast in action.

40018323.author: पदार्थः
40018323.content: शरीरेषु in the body, प्रहरन्तम् hitting, राघवम् Raghava, ते they, इन्द्रियार्थेषु experienced through sense objects, तिष्ठन्तम् enjoying, भूतात्मानम् created beings, प्रजाःइव like people, न पश्यन्ति not able to perceive

40018323.author: Translation
40018323.content: Just as created beings experience their senses and do not perceive their soul, the army experienced the hitting of Raghava by their senses but were not able to perceive him who was hitting them.

40018324.author: पदार्थः
40018324.content: एषः in that way, गजानीकम् elephants, हन्तिkilling, एषः in the same way, महारथान् mighty chariot warriors, हन्ति destroying, एषः so also, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, वाजिभिःसह including horses, पदातीन् foot soldiers, हन्ति killing, इति thus, सर्वे all, तेराक्षसाः those, रणे in battle, रामस्य Rama's, सदृशान् staying there, कुपिताःangry, राघवस्य Raghava's, सादृश्यात् resembled, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नुःattacked

40018324.author: Translation
40018324.content: 'Rama is here killing elephants', 'Here is Rama destroying chariot warriors', 'Rama is killing horses, foot soldiers with sharp arrows', saying like that, the Rakshasas were striking one another in the battle. Being there where Rama was, they were mistaking one another for Rama there because of the socalled resemblance and attacking one another.

40018325.author: पदार्थः
40018325.content: एषः in that way, गजानीकम् elephants, हन्तिkilling, एषः in the same way, महारथान् mighty chariot warriors, हन्ति destroying, एषः so also, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, वाजिभिःसह including horses, पदातीन् foot soldiers, हन्ति killing, इति thus, सर्वे all, तेराक्षसाः those, रणे in battle, रामस्य Rama's, सदृशान् staying there, कुपिताःangry, राघवस्य Raghava's, सादृश्यात् resembled, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नुःattacked

40018325.author: Translation
40018325.content: 'Rama is here killing elephants', 'Here is Rama destroying chariot warriors', 'Rama is killing horses, foot soldiers with sharp arrows', saying like that, the Rakshasas were striking one another in the battle. Being there where Rama was, they were mistaking one another for Rama there because of the socalled resemblance and attacking one another.

40018326.author: पदार्थः
40018326.content: महात्मना great soul, गान्धर्वेणmissile presided over by G and arvas, परमास्त्रण supreme missile, मोहितः confused, ते they, वाहिनीम् army, दहन्तमपि burning, रामम् Rama, न ददृशिरे not able to see

40018326.author: Translation
40018326.content: The Rakshasas got confused by the supreme missile presided over by Gandharvas, released by Rama, which was burning their army, and were not able to see.

40018327.author: पदार्थः
40018327.content: रणे in war, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, रामसहस्राणि thousand Ramas, पश्यन्ति saw, महाहवे great battle, पुनः again, एकम् one, काकुत्स्थमेव kakuthsa alone, पश्यन्ति could see

40018327.author: Translation
40018327.content: In the battle those Rakshasas could see a thousand Ramas at one place and again one Rama alone at another place

40018328.author: पदार्थः
40018328.content: ते they, महात्मनः great soul, कार्मुकस्य bow's, भ्रमन्ती confusion, काञ्चनीम् golden, अलातचक्रप्रतिमाम् going round in circles, कोटिम् burning firestick, ददृशुः saw, राघवम् Raghava, न not

40018328.author: Translation
40018328.content: While Rama was going around in circles with his bow, the Rakshasas were confused, and saw the golden ends of the bow to be like a burning fire stick circling and could not see Rama.

40018329.author: पदार्थः
40018329.content: प्रजाः people, शरीरनाभिः body as centre of discuss, सत्त्वार्चिः strength as glow, शरारम् arrows as spokes, नेमिकार्मुकम् bow for belly, ज्याघोषतलनिर्घोषम् twangling of the bow string, तेजोबुधदिगुणप्रभम् virtues and effulgence as power of missiles, दिव्यास्त्रगुणपर्यन्तम् power of mystic missiles, युधि in war, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, निघ्नन्तम् killing, कालचक्रमिव like the wheel of time spirit, रामचक्रम् Rama's wheel, ददृशुः seen

40018329.author: Translation
40018329.content: People saw Rama in the form of wheel exterminating the Rakshasas on the battlefield, which had the body of Sri Rama as its navel, his strength as its glow, the arrows as spokes, his bow as belly, the twangling of the bowstring as its sound, his virtues and effulgence as the power of his mystic missiles in war. Rama was seen as a wheel of time spirit by the people.

40018330.author: पदार्थः
40018330.content: प्रजाः people, शरीरनाभिः body as centre of discuss, सत्त्वार्चिः strength as glow, शरारम् arrows as spokes, नेमिकार्मुकम् bow for belly, ज्याघोषतलनिर्घोषम् twangling of the bow string, तेजोबुधदिगुणप्रभम् virtues and effulgence as power of missiles, दिव्यास्त्रगुणपर्यन्तम् power of mystic missiles, युधि in war, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, निघ्नन्तम् killing, कालचक्रमिव like the wheel of time spirit, रामचक्रम् Rama's wheel, ददृशुः seen

40018330.author: Translation
40018330.content: People saw Rama in the form of wheel exterminating the Rakshasas on the battlefield, which had the body of Sri Rama as its navel, his strength as its glow, the arrows as spokes, his bow as belly, the twangling of the bowstring as its sound, his virtues and effulgence as the power of his mystic missiles in war. Rama was seen as a wheel of time spirit by the people.

40018331.author: पदार्थः
40018331.content: कामरूपिणाम् capable of changing form at will, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वातरम्हसाम् of wind speed, रथानाम् chariots, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, अनीकम् army, तरस्विनाम् fleetfooted, कुञ्जराणाम् elephants, अष्टादश eighteen, सहस्राणि thousands, सारोहाणाम् with riders, वाजिनाम् horses, चतुर्दशforty, सहस्राणि thousands, पदातिनाम् foot soldiers, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, पूर्णे fully, द्वे two, शतसहस्रे hundred thousands, एकेनalone, रामेण by Rama, दिवसस्य in a day, अष्टभागेन eighth part, अग्निशिखोपमैः resembling tongues of fire, शरैः arrows, हतानि were killed

40018331.author: Translation
40018331.content: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.

40018332.author: पदार्थः
40018332.content: कामरूपिणाम् capable of changing form at will, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वातरम्हसाम् of wind speed, रथानाम् chariots, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, अनीकम् army, तरस्विनाम् fleetfooted, कुञ्जराणाम् elephants, अष्टादश eighteen, सहस्राणि thousands, सारोहाणाम् with riders, वाजिनाम् horses, चतुर्दशforty, सहस्राणि thousands, पदातिनाम् foot soldiers, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, पूर्णे fully, द्वे two, शतसहस्रे hundred thousands, एकेनalone, रामेण by Rama, दिवसस्य in a day, अष्टभागेन eighth part, अग्निशिखोपमैः resembling tongues of fire, शरैः arrows, हतानि were killed

40018332.author: Translation
40018332.content: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.

40018333.author: पदार्थः
40018333.content: कामरूपिणाम् capable of changing form at will, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वातरम्हसाम् of wind speed, रथानाम् chariots, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, अनीकम् army, तरस्विनाम् fleetfooted, कुञ्जराणाम् elephants, अष्टादश eighteen, सहस्राणि thousands, सारोहाणाम् with riders, वाजिनाम् horses, चतुर्दशforty, सहस्राणि thousands, पदातिनाम् foot soldiers, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, पूर्णे fully, द्वे two, शतसहस्रे hundred thousands, एकेनalone, रामेण by Rama, दिवसस्य in a day, अष्टभागेन eighth part, अग्निशिखोपमैः resembling tongues of fire, शरैः arrows, हतानि were killed

40018333.author: Translation
40018333.content: In the eighth part of the day, in the battlefield, an army of Rakshasas who were capable of changing their forms at will, constituting a myriad of chariots with wind speed, eighteen thousand fleetfooted elephants, fourteen thousand horses with riders, two lakh Rakshasas fighting on foot exterminated by Rama singlehanded with his arrows that resembled tongues of fire.

40018334.author: पदार्थः
40018334.content: हताश्वाः dead, हतरथाः chariots destroyed, शान्ताःappeased, विमथितध्वजाः staff of chariots broken, हतशेषाः rest killed, तेनिशाचराः those night rangers, लङ्कांपुरीम् into Lanka, अभिपेतुः returned

40018334.author: Translation
40018334.content: Rakshasas dead, chariots destroyed, staff of chariots broken, remaining Rakshasas returned to Lanka.

40018335.author: पदार्थः
40018335.content: हतैः killed, गजपदात्यश्वैःelephants, foot soldiers, horses तत् there, रणाजिरम् the battlefield, क्रुद्धस्य angry, महात्मनः great, रुद्रस्य Rudra's, अक्रीडभूमिःइव sports in field, बभूव seen

40018335.author: Translation
40018335.content: With the elephants, horses, and foot soldiers killed, the battlefield was like the ground where mighty Rudra sported in anger.

40018336.author: पदार्थः
40018336.content: ततः then, सगन्धर्वाः the Gandharvas, देवाः Devas, सिद्धाश्च Siddhas, परमर्षयः very happy, रामस्य Rama's, तत् कर्म that action, साधुसाधुइति well done well done, समपूजयन् offered prayers

40018336.author: Translation
40018336.content: Then, the Gandharvas, Devas, and Siddhas were very happy and praised Sri Rama saying, 'well done, well done' and offered prayers.

40018337.author: पदार्थः
40018337.content: तदा then, धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, प्रत्यनन्तरम् nearby, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, विभीषणं च and Vibheeshana, वानरम् vanaars, हनूमन्तं च and Hanuman, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, हरिश्रेष्ठम् leaders of Vanaras, मैन्धम् Mainda, द्विविदमेव च Dwivida, अब्रवीच्छ spoke, एतत् this, दिव्यम् wonderful, अस्त्रबलम् power of arrows, ममवा mine or, त्ऱ्यम्बकस्यवा Lord siva

40018337.author: Translation
40018337.content: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.

40018338.author: पदार्थः
40018338.content: तदा then, धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, प्रत्यनन्तरम् nearby, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, विभीषणं च and Vibheeshana, वानरम् vanaars, हनूमन्तं च and Hanuman, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, हरिश्रेष्ठम् leaders of Vanaras, मैन्धम् Mainda, द्विविदमेव च Dwivida, अब्रवीच्छ spoke, एतत् this, दिव्यम् wonderful, अस्त्रबलम् power of arrows, ममवा mine or, त्ऱ्यम्बकस्यवा Lord siva

40018338.author: Translation
40018338.content: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.
